rationale: positive first checks path validity, then admits the root, every strict prefix of an entry, and each valid descendant of a positive entry. negative is membership of the exact signed negative entry, so it does not propagate emptiness below that slot. Pos and Neg turn those Boolean predicates into propositions. Full quantifies over every positive path, its class declaration, and each direct field, requiring a positive or negative extension; it does not require every slot to be initialized. These clauses match each prose bullet and the displayed quantifiers. unit:given.typing.views supplies paths, signs, base, finite views and whole-type shorthand; unit:given.typing.declarations supplies nominal declarations. The all-finite-path quantification also covers recursive declarations without an infinite syntactic view.
limitations: This is a comparison of authored meaning, formal definitions, theorem assumptions and quantifiers, and example setup/results. Proof correctness is left to Lean; the reviewer did not run Lean, Cargo tests, rendering, or evidence validation.
